Distinct field from the data-rows family's defensive-automaton#hp row (ancestryHp).

Code-only fix, no data row: the grant belongs in src/rules/featFeatGrants.ts EXTRA_FEAT_TAKINGS ('newly-minted-automaton': [{ feat: 'additional-lore', variant: 'heritage' }]), which is outside this family's files - listed as a CROSS-FILE GAP. The build.ts reader (EXTRA_FEAT_TAKINGS walk over the heritage-seeded queue) already exists; test/batch038-engine.test.ts pins it with the row set on the table in memory.
